sloka: किं नु मे न गुणाः के चित्किं वा भाग्य क्षयो हि मे ।याहं सीता वरार्हेण हीना रामेण भामिनी ।। ५.२४.४२।।।।
transliteration: kiṁ nu me na guṇāḥ ke citkiṁ vā bhāgya kṣayo hi me ।yāhaṁ sītā varārheṇa hīnā rāmeṇa bhāminī ।। 5.24.42।।।।

translations.english: Next spoke an ogress called Praghasa, saying 'Why not we twist and squeeze the neck of this heartless lady. Why are you sitting idle still? Come on.'
